app: Control design: Remote Config SDK installed and fetching, but used as a banner toy -- defaults set for the banner only and never synced, fetch on every foreground with a 0-second interval (throttled in production), no real-time listener, version read but compared only in a debug screen, no forced update, a flexible prompt whose store link is a hardcoded web URL, no kill switch, rollouts done by shipping binaries, the paywall hardcodes an offering identifier so experiments never reach users, fetch failures unmeasured, version distribution never read, and no test change ever verified on a device.
